name: Kazakhstan rural household electricity per-capita proxy with community-service planning uplift
interpretation: The national household component is derived from 2022 rural-household electricity consumption divided by the official rural-population estimate. The 1.25 community-service multiplier is a SteppeGrid researcher-defined planning assumption for a modest public/service allowance. It is not a measured village electricity statistic or confidence interval.

provenance.source_name: Kazakhstan Bureau of National Statistics — Fuel and energy consumption in households (2022)
provenance.notes: Reports 4,827.4 GWh annual electricity consumption by rural households.

provenance.source_name: Kazakhstan Bureau of National Statistics — demographic situation, January–July 2022
provenance.notes: Reports 7.533 million rural residents as of 1 August 2022.
Researcher-defined 1.25 multiplier; not an observed national or village statistic.
